headline: Tell Your Watch to Hold That Pose
snippet: A new app will use high-resolution photographs to authenticate timepieces.

headline: IBM Looks to Its Next Century
snippet: A venerable technology company is adopting a strategy that moves it into disruptive systems.

headline: Ai Weiwei Plans a Celebration, of Sorts, to Mark Demolition of His Studio
snippet: Mr. Ai wrote he will hold a “River Crab Fest” at his Shanghai studio, which the Chinese government is demolishing – “river crab” being a bit of Chinese slang for censorship.

headline: Welcome to the Machines: Designing Useful Robots
snippet: Lesson Plan | A problem-based learning activity in which students design robots to address real-world challenges.

headline: Protecting Your Home From Afar With a Robot
snippet: Wi-Fi-equipped robots can be operated remotely to protect a home. Some can even be modified to detect fire and carry an extinguisher.
